sources.normalization: Response length echoes requested page size, not actual list length. Validate list/count and pagination. Select latest by result_date for exact beach_id; preserve censored numeric strings and date-only precision.
sources.freshness: Selected in-season samples dated September 7–15. Retrieved September 22; no fetch-time relabelling.
sources.coverage: Annual profiles, bacterial samples, and active in-season incident notices. No site water temperature, waves or currents in the inspected responses.
sources.limitations: Docs distinguish voluntary out-of-season samples (September 16–May 21), but the retrieved Swagger currently lists only Locations and Alerts paths. A documented machine endpoint and completeness rules for out-of-season measurements remain unresolved. Alert local timestamps lack offsets; timezone/cancellation and in-season applicability need explicit normalization. No current safety all-clear inferred.
sources.nextStep: Before activation: resolve out-of-season endpoint, units, timestamp convention and alert coverage; implement shared collector adapter, exact site targets, date/censoring/error tests and transactional import in the configured project. Research JSON is not an adapter.

sources.units: degree_C, depth m (positive up), time UTC; missing temperature -999; QFlag must be respected.
sources.evidence: Actual station/coordinate list lies on west/northwest coasts (easternmost longitude -7.55028); none at these east-coast beaches. No nearest-station substitution.
sources.additionalScope: Offshore weather-buoy documentation screened only, not a verified local beach observation.

sources.limitations: Current API contains agricultural blight as well as marine gale/small-craft warnings, including future onset dates. Do not treat all warnings as current swimming hazards. Exact marine-area boundaries, cancellations and reuse/rate policy remain unverified; no location binding enabled.
